pages.title: Get the Guide
pages.text: Install Patchouli for your Minecraft version and loader on the server and clients.$(br2)This guide appears in the Simply Screens creative tab.

pages.title: Get the Guide
pages.text: Craft another copy with a book and an amethyst shard.

pages.title: Optional Guide
pages.text: Simply Screens works without Patchouli.$(br2)Only this guide and its recipe are unavailable. Use Playlists for slideshows and Up next for temporary images.
